BAh7CEkiCGdpZAY6BkVUSSI6Z2lkOi8vanVtcHN0.description:
I let AI interview me about what I actually do at work, and it found AI opportunities I had been missing.

In this video, I break down the Clarityboard process: a structured AI conversation that maps what you really do, where your time actually goes, and which tasks should be automated, AI-assisted, delegated, or eliminated.

If you’ve ever asked, “Where should AI actually fit into my role?” this is the framework.

*Clarityboard template:*
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1fOTfaiHLZ0WXVT-qNg4p6IRu5auBHsztOX51dpApHSE/edit?usp=sharing

*What you’ll see in this video:*
- how AI found missed opportunities in real work
- why job descriptions hide the best AI wins
- the 7-phase Clarityboard framework
- how to use AI to map your role more accurately
- how to turn that into practical next steps with your manager
